title: Packaged broadcast trigger/remove smoke
minimumPromotionPolicy: Packaged broadcast trigger/remove smoke promotion requires install-run evidence for opted-in receiver metadata, descriptor registration, bounded payload trigger delivery, remove cleanup, relaunch, crash recovery, metadata mismatch denial, undeclared-capability denial, exported receiver policy, rollback, and Safe downgrade before tasks.broadcast can be promoted.

triggerRemoveMatrix.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK verifies compat IntentTask rejection, future module denial, raw global absence, JavaScript-only BroadcastChannel, surface presence, and metadata denial.
Packaged APK registers an app-local or package-private custom trigger, receives one bounded JSON payload, records task id/action/timestamp, and does not expose raw Android objects.
Remove disables or deletes the owned descriptor, unregisters dynamic receivers or removes owned manifest patches, cancels pending executions, and prevents later trigger delivery.
Relaunch and crash recovery preserve visible descriptors without duplicate receiver registration or orphan pending executions.
Undeclared tasks.broadcast capabilities reject before dispatch; exported receiver requests reject unless explicit reviewed metadata and permission policy are present.
Metadata mismatch, package identity mismatch, provider disable, rollback, and Safe downgrade deny trigger authority and remove or disable only owned receiver patches.

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-21 imports current packaged IntentTask/broadcast boundary denial smoke and reserves future trigger/remove/relaunch/exported receiver archives.
P15-15 keeps intent_broadcast unpromoted and validates descriptor, manifest/export, payload/remove, disclosure, rollback, and runtime denial contracts.
The intent_broadcast provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The intent_broadcast provider declares disable flags, diagnostics, disclosure fields, packaged downgrade behavior, and Safe downgrade requirements.
P15-16 owns P14-21 under pro.tasks_device_media with packaged_smoke_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK positive trigger archive for app-local or package-private broadcast descriptor registration, payload delivery, and JSON-only payload validation.
Packaged remove cleanup archive proving owned descriptor cleanup, receiver unregister or manifest patch cleanup, pending execution cancellation, and no post-remove delivery.
Packaged relaunch and crash recovery archive proving no duplicate receivers, orphan pending executions, or lost visible descriptors.
Packaged denial archive for missing tasks.broadcast capabilities, unsupported triggers, metadata mismatch, and exported receiver requests.
Packaged exported receiver policy archive with explicit metadata, allowlist, permission model, abuse review, and Android 12/15+ evidence before any exported receiver is promoted.
Packaged metadata mismatch and package identity mismatch denial evidence proving receiver patches cannot be replayed or aliased across owners.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that package-owned receiver patches, descriptors, and pending executions are removed or disabled while broadcast trigger authority is denied.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before packaged broadcast trigger/remove smoke can be marked promoted.
